title: Text: DET Doug Teter ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Are you guys having testing issues?
If it’s a “yes,” same as everyone else, that’s different than a “no,” same as everyone else, though
Not as bad as some are reporting
Not doing anything with it but I’m just ... waiting. As of a couple days ago, one player got tested on Monday, inconclusive and then nothing else
Last Monday. And I see some of these teams making noise about it and
I understand why teams don’t want to make noise about it

Yeah some teams have been very vocal.  Not sure if that helps the problem.  It’s an enormous task they are trying to run and streamline.  I’m actually empathetic to the issues the testing protocols have encountered.  I’m amazed it’s running as well as it is
